params.name: S1

structures.name: S1
structures.title: Inverse ink meter
structures.hypothesis: Inverse ink meter: Its map is lowered by every inked pixel, wherever it is and whichever way the stroke runs, so its average falls as the digit gets more ink: it is highest for thin 1s and lowest for heavy 0s and 8s. So thickening the strokes should lower it strongly, while a stroke of the same length should take away about the same wherever it is placed and whichever way it runs. Self-probe: Thicken every stroke by one pixel (dilation) vs move the digit one pixel right: -1.51 SD against the control (95% interval -1.54 to -1.48, 1000 images; predicted down): agrees. A 10-pixel '\' stroke through the centre of the digit vs the same stroke '/': -0.06 SD against the control (95% interval -0.08 to -0.03, 1000 images; predicted no change): agrees. A 10-pixel horizontal stroke along the top of the digit vs the same stroke along its bottom: -0.09 SD against the control (95% interval -0.11 to -0.07, 1000 images; predicted no change): agrees.
